title: Sliding Window Maximum
statement: For every window of k consecutive readings, print the maximum reading in that window.
input_format: The first line contains n and k. The second line contains n integers.
output_format: Print n - k + 1 integers separated by spaces.
hints: Recomputing the maximum of every window from scratch is too slow.
Keep a double-ended queue of positions whose values are decreasing.
Drop positions that left the window from the front and smaller values from the back.
